facts.summary: Two Phase 3 DME studies missed primary endpoint, cataract signal, program discontinued · Phase 3 · tarcocimab tedromer in DME and wet AMD · not yet approved
facts.indication: diabetic macular edema (DME) and wet AMD

evidence.summary: the GLEAM and GLIMMER studies did not meet their primary efficacy endpoints of showing non-inferior visual acuity gains for tarcocimab dosed every 8 to 24 weeks after 3 monthly loading doses compared to aflibercept
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the GLEAM and GLIMMER studies did not meet their primary efficacy endpoints of showing non-inferior visual acuity gains for tarcocimab dosed every 8 to 24 weeks after 3 monthly loading doses compared to aflibercept
evidence.safety: An unexpected increase in cataract adverse events was reported over time in the tarcocimab arms of both GLEAM and GLIMMER with 19% on tarcocimab versus 9% on aflibercept
evidence.program_discontinued: Kodiak has determined to discontinue further development of tarcocimab.
